about: Takes the files a person picks, drops or pastes, and lists them with their sizes. It checks each file against the types, sizes and count it accepts, and lists a refused file with its reasons.

attachments.about: The page keeps the files in its state and adds up their size. `validate` refuses a file that would take the total over 25 MB, and the field reports how many it refused. The clear button removes every file.
attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.over_one: {{count}} file would take the attachments over 25 MB.
attachments.over_other: {{count}} files would take the attachments over 25 MB.
attachments.title: A total limit

evidence.about: A required upload in a form. A submit with no file marks the field invalid and shows its error text. Adding a file clears it.
evidence.drop: Drop photos or PDFs here, or press to choose
evidence.label: Proof of delivery
evidence.needed: Add at least one photo or PDF.
evidence.title: Required in a form

folder.about: `directory` asks the picker for a folder, and the upload takes every CSV file in it. Each row shows the file's path inside the folder.
folder.label: Bank exports
folder.title: A folder of files

photo.about: One image with its picture in the row. On a phone `capture` opens the front camera. A second photo replaces the first.
photo.drop: Drop a photo here, or press to take one
photo.label: Profile photo
photo.title: A photo and its preview

receipts.drop: Drop receipts here, or press to choose
receipts.hint: PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF, up to 5 MB each
receipts.label: Receipts

refused.about: The upload takes PDFs up to 2 MB, three at most. A refused file goes into a list of its own with its reasons, which the example maps from the machine's codes to words.
refused.drop: Drop invoices here, or press to choose
refused.hint: PDF only, up to 2 MB each
refused.label: Invoices
refused.title: Refused files and why

screenshots.about: Tab to the area and paste an image from the clipboard. `transformFiles` renames a pasted image, which a browser names image.png, after the time it arrived.
screenshots.hint: A pasted image takes the time it arrived as its name
screenshots.label: Screenshots
screenshots.paste: Paste a screenshot here, or drop one
screenshots.title: Pasted screenshots

size.about: The sizes a field and a fieldset pass down. The dropzone is at least 128, 160 or 192px tall, and each row's preview is the control height.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: Invalid, read-only and disabled. A read-only or disabled upload takes the dropzone out of the tab order and disables its buttons.
states.title: States

statement.about: One PDF behind a button. A second file replaces the first, and the row's button removes it.
statement.label: Bank statement
statement.title: Behind a button

title: File upload

variant.about: The outline look fills the dropzone with the panel, and the subtle look with the subtle ground. Both dash the field's edge.
variant.title: Looks
